chatgpt.label: everyday text chats
chatgpt.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna model. Files, images, voice and data analysis have separate limits that are not published.

claude.label: rolling usage window
claude.summary: No fixed message count is published. Limits depend on conversation length and features used.

gemini.label: tokens of context
gemini.summary: Flash-Lite model. The usage limit refreshes every 5 hours.
gemini.note: Two official pages describe some features (Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas) differently, so we list only what is clear.

grok.label: limits not stated
grok.summary: Chat, image and video, voice and file analysis. The official page gives no usage numbers.

copilot.label: no sign-in needed
copilot.summary: Chat, web answers and image creation. Signing in adds chat history and voice.

perplexity.label: Pro searches
perplexity.summary: 1 research query a month. Basic searches are practically unlimited.

deepseek.label: could not verify
deepseek.summary: The official site publishes no free plan limits, so we make no claims.
